Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 04/06/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 373 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Labor by an undetermined amount by requiring the Department to report annually to the Legislature on the efficacy of fraud detection and prevention measures used by the Department and the amount of fraudulent unemployment benefits recovered. This bill will not otherwise affect state of local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
